{{Otheruses|Canister}}
A '''T-238 canister''' was an ammunition type for use with the [[CSPL-12 projectile launcher/Legends|CSPL-12]] [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile launcher]]. It contained [[Agent T-238]], a chemical agent that caused nausea and incapacitated targets.
